# ACTIVE TASK: TASK-001

Title: Third-Person Character Controller & Dual Character Switching (Eimi & Asch)
System: Gameplay Engineering
Objective: Implement responsive third-person movement (WASD + camera-relative) and a seamless character switch button ('Tab' or Gamepad 'Y') between Eimi and Asch with preserved momentum and distinct camera offsets.
Dependencies: Three.js core scene, input manager
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Smooth third-person orbit camera following active player character.
2. Instant character swap retaining world position and camera angle.
3. Unique speeds: Eimi (8.0 m/s sprint), Asch (5.5 m/s jog).
4. Clean state transition without memory leaks or duplicate meshes.
